turns_text: [SEG0001] person_1 (CLINICAL_STAFF): Meera ji, Doctor is free, you can take Arjun in. He was so quiet in the waiting area, no?
[SEG0002] person_2 (DOCTOR): Come, sit, both of you. Tell me, what has been going on with him?
[SEG0003] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Doctor, since two nights he is just crying and crying, holding the ear. It started after the cold only.
[SEG0004] person_2 (DOCTOR): Which ear is he holding, the right or the left?
[SEG0005] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Right one mostly. Left side he is not touching at all.
[SEG0006] person_2 (DOCTOR): Arjun, beta, can you show me where it is hurting?
[SEG0007] person_4 (PATIENT): Ear.
[SEG0008] person_2 (DOCTOR): This right one?
[SEG0009] person_4 (PATIENT): Yes.
[SEG0010] person_2 (DOCTOR): Is it paining the whole day, or more when he lies down?
[SEG0011] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Daytime he plays, then suddenly cries. Night time only he is screaming, we were up till two.
[SEG0012] person_4 (PATIENT): Hurts.
[SEG0013] person_2 (DOCTOR): How long has the crying been, and the cold before that?
[SEG0014] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Crying is two nights. Cold was there from last week, runny nose and a little cough. Cough is almost gone now.
[SEG0015] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any fever in these days?

[SEG0016] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): No fever. I checked yesterday night, thermometer was ninety eight point four Fahrenheit. My mother stays with us, she said he was hot to touch in the evening, but I don't agree, the reading was normal.
[SEG0017] person_2 (DOCTOR): Is he taking food and water?
[SEG0018] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Water he is drinking. Food, only two spoons, he pushes the plate. Morning he wanted biscuits though, then he left them.
[SEG0019] person_2 (DOCTOR): Arjun, tummy pain?
[SEG0020] person_4 (PATIENT): No.
[SEG0021] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any pus or watery discharge from the ear?
[SEG0022] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): No, nothing coming out. I checked with the torch.
[SEG0023] person_2 (DOCTOR): Any medicines he takes regularly, or anything from before I should know?

[SEG0024] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): No regular medicines. Um, long ago, when he was a baby, the child specialist gave amoxicillin. I think he got a rash, maybe. I'm not sure, could have been the viral only.
[SEG0025] person_2 (DOCTOR): Do you remember if the rash started after the syrup?
[SEG0026] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Not really. My husband says there were some red spots, I only half remember. It is all mixed up.
[SEG0027] person_2 (DOCTOR): Okay, we will be careful with that. Let me look in the ear, just a small light, beta, you can sit on Amma's lap.
[SEG0028] person_2 (DOCTOR): Right drum is a bit pink and dull, not bulging badly. Left ear is clear. Throat is mildly red, chest is clear, and he is in no distress.
[SEG0029] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): So it is an infection, doctor? His nursery teacher also had sent a note, but that is a different thing, about the fancy dress.

[SEG0030] person_2 (DOCTOR): I think this is most likely a mild ear infection after the cold, or just the tube blocked from the cold. I am not fully sure, and I don't want to start an antibiotic today.
[SEG0031] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): He was inconsolable at two in the morning. I felt terrible, actually.

[SEG0032] person_2 (DOCTOR): Nights are the worst, I know. For the pain, give paracetamol, the two hundred and fifty milligram syrup, six ml every six hours if he is hurting. That comes to three hundred milligrams.
[SEG0033] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): We have Crocin at home, the two-fifty one. Same, no?

[SEG0034] person_2 (DOCTOR): Yes, use that Crocin. If the pain is still there after two days, or if you measure a real fever, then we start an antibiotic, cefpodoxime, not amoxicillin, because of that maybe rash. I am not giving it today.
[SEG0035] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): And if even that doesn't settle? My mother will ask me all this.
[SEG0036] person_2 (DOCTOR): If it does not settle, we might do a scan, though I doubt we will need it. Let's see him in two days.
[SEG0037] person_3 (FAMILY_MEMBER): Two days, alright. Should I put warm oil in the ear? My mother was insisting.

[SEG0038] person_2 (DOCTOR): Please don't put oil or anything inside the ear. Keep offering him water, and if he turns very drowsy or the pain becomes severe before those two days, come sooner, don't wait.
